headline: Decision point: five improvement routes measured, all five refused by the out-of-sample filter. The champion holds at +25.71% on sealed 2026.
target: Sealed 2026 is the exam · beat +25.71% · minimum +30%/year · every year positive

gpu_job.title: Idle — awaiting the operator's decision on direction
gpu_job.exam: next: A96 reference markets (DXY, gold, NASDAQ, VIX, rates)

steps.title: Audit the whole training path, by probe not by reading
steps.detail: 10 seams measured: features causal bit-for-bit, execution structurally honest; 2 faults found and queued

steps.title: Deep-field net — sees 127 of its 96 bars (champion sees 15)
steps.detail: won EVERY research metric, then lost the exam: sealed 2026 −18.04% vs champion +25.71% — memorisation, not skill

steps.title: Walk-forward instrument: train ≤2024, exam on 2025 alone
steps.detail: VALIDATED — it agrees with the sealed year (deep net: −25.84% vs control −6.54%, same trade-inflation signature). Now the standing gate for every model change

steps.title: Ensemble of 5 seed-varied nets, champion architecture, walk-forward
steps.detail: WON the exam: unseen 2025 +6.46% (DD 16.4%, 45 trades) vs single seed −6.54% (DD 21.9%, 72 trades) — first candidate ever to win a walk-forward A/B

steps.title: Ensemble second exam — train ≤2023, examine 2024
steps.detail: single won: unseen 2024 +22.36% vs ensemble +16.95%. 1-of-2 → no sealed reading. But the pair shows the ensemble trims BOTH tails: positive in both exam years (single lost one), compounded +24.5% vs +14.4%

steps.title: Ensemble third exam — train ≤2022, examine 2023
steps.detail: ensemble LOSES the series. 2023: single +2.91% vs ensemble −26.25%. Mandate lens over 3 exams: both 2/3 years positive, tiebreak mean min(ret,30%) single +0.0624 vs ensemble −0.0095. The 2025 win was the draw — the 2-of-2 rule saved a sealed reading

steps.title: Joint threshold search — Bayesian TPE over all 33 levers
steps.detail: CLOSED at 1,668 combinations (1,602 distinct). Only 1% beat the champion on the fitted years; the best of them GAINS +0.0160 on fit and LOSES −0.0154 out of sample. Verdict: the champion's thresholds already sit at a generalising optimum

steps.title: Recency-weighted training — the market evolves, weight recent years
steps.detail: WON exam 1 on unseen 2025: half-life 2y +1.16% (DD 15.6%) vs no-decay control −6.54% (DD 21.9%). Half-life 4y −6.30% ≈ control, so the response is ORDERED with the lever — and the win came with LOWER drawdown, not more risk

steps.title: Recency exam 2 — confirm half-life 2y on unseen 2024
steps.detail: CONFIRMATION FAILS. Unseen 2024: half-life 2y −7.76% at 32.9% drawdown vs the +22.36% control at 17.9%. 1-of-2, so exam 1's win was the draw — same shape as the ensemble. No sealed reading. The exploratory 1y arm beat the control (+24.92%) but adopts nothing: it starts its own series

steps.title: Shorter receptive fields — if 15 bars beats 127, where is the optimum?
steps.detail: the champion's reach was never chosen; measure below it

steps.title: Macro channel: Fed, CPI, payrolls, oil — sizing/veto, point-in-time
steps.detail: exogenous risk trigger — the operator's ‘smaller trades when the world is tense’

steps.title: Reference markets as inputs: DXY, gold, NASDAQ, VIX, rates
steps.detail: cheapest test of ‘other markets carry information for this book’

steps.title: Cross-asset corpus: equities, FX, gold — more independent episodes
steps.detail: crypto is one risk factor sampled 27 times; independence is the scarce input

verdicts.text: Recency weighting refused: won unseen 2025 (+1.16% vs −6.54%) and lost unseen 2024 (−7.76% vs +22.36%). Five routes measured, five refused — the champion holds

FIRST REAL SIGNAL — the operator's own idea: recency-weighted training (half-life 2y) turns unseen 2025 from −6.54% into +1.16% with lower drawdown, and 4y decay reproduces the control, so the response follows the lever. Exam 2 running before anything is claimed
Ensemble retired: won exam 1 (+6.46% vs −6.54%), lost exams 2 and 3 (+16.95 vs +22.36; −26.25 vs +2.91). One exam year is a coin flip — the pre-registered rule saved a sealed reading
Threshold search CLOSED: 1,668 combinations say the champion's values are already at a generalising optimum — the 1% that fit better do not transfer (fit +0.0160, held-out −0.0154)
Second exam: single seed wins raw 2024 (+22.36% vs +16.95%) — no sealed reading. The ensemble was positive in BOTH exam years though; a third exam arbitrates under the mandate lens
Ensemble of 5 wins the walk-forward exam: +6.46% on unseen 2025 vs −6.54% single-seed, with lower drawdown and fewer trades — the variance-reduction signature
